name: Fairmont Banff Springs
positioning: Historic Fairmont Banff Springs hotel in the Canadian Rockies, just minutes from the Town of Banff, with a spa, two golf courses and 12 restaurants, pubs and bars
best_for: Families wanting bunk-bed rooms and bookable family excursions
Travelers who want golf and a spa at the hotel
Guests who want many places to eat and drink on site

facts.text: Construction of the original hotel began in 1886.
A 1926 fire destroyed much of the original wooden structure, and the hotel was rebuilt as guests experience it today.
The hotel was winterized in the late 1960s, allowing it to open year-round.
The hotel is located just minutes from the Town of Banff.
The property has 12 restaurants, pubs and bars.
1888 Chop House is a signature restaurant serving Alberta beef, seafood and wild game.
The outdoor pool has views of Mount Rundle.
The Fairmont Spa has treatment rooms, an indoor mineral pool, plunge pools, steam rooms and lounges.
The property has Tunnel Mountain 9-hole and Stanley Thompson 18-hole golf courses.
The property offers dedicated bookable family excursions.

highlights.text: Notable guests have included King George VI and Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother.
Room views overlook the Canadian Rockies and the Bow River.
Gatehouse rooms near the Adventure Centre include family rooms with built-in bunk beds.
Castello Italiana has indoor dining under an imported olive tree from Italy.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury mountain resort positioning.
WhataHotel notes the large historic property may require walking between facilities.
